method.method_draft: First describe the image by partitioning it into fragments. Count the two cyclohexyl rings as 6 + 6 non-H single bonds. Count the right-hand alcohol-derived fragment: O–C = 1 plus C–R1 and C–R2 = 2, excluding O–H and C–H. Sum these contributions to obtain 24.
